calculation_handling.description: A rear addition to a detached house erected before October 15, 1953 is permitted only if the overall floor space index of the lot, including the addition, does not exceed 0.69.
calculation_handling.gaps: The construction date of the existing house is not held; the cap applies only on the rear-addition path for a pre-1953 detached house.

units.disclosure: This 0.69 FSI cap governs only rear additions to detached houses built before October 15, 1953; we cannot confirm the construction date.

calculation_handling.description: Finished floor levels in a rear addition may be no higher than the uppermost floor level of the existing building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Floor levels of the existing building are not held, and no DSL target expresses a floor level relative to the existing building.

units.disclosure: For a rear addition to a pre-1953 detached house, the addition's floors may not be higher than the existing top floor; we do not evaluate this.

calculation_handling.description: No part of a rear addition may be closer to the nearest side lot line than the existing side main wall of the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The existing side main wall distance is not held.

units.disclosure: A rear addition may not come closer to the side lot line than the existing house's side wall; we do not hold the existing wall position, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Any prior addition to the house must be at least 5 years old before a further rear addition is permitted.
calculation_handling.gaps: The age of prior additions is not held and no DSL target expresses it.

units.disclosure: A rear addition is permitted only if any earlier addition is at least 5 years old; we do not hold addition history, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.40.60(1), a platform in a front or rear yard with a floor higher than the first floor of the building may not encroach into the required yard setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: Platform encroachments are not evaluated.

units.disclosure: In the front or rear yard, a deck or platform higher than the first floor may not project into the required setback; we do not evaluate platforms.

900.3.10(303).explanation: Exception RD 303 keeps each lot's 2013 frontage and area as the minimums, sets front setbacks of 30 m from the Ellesmere Rd. centreline and 9.0 m on Pharmacy Ave., 0.9 m side setbacks (3.6 m on a street side), and 0.3 m for garages from an interior side lot line.

900.3.10(1321).explanation: Exception RD 1321 lets a detached house built before October 15, 1953 add a rear addition if the lot stays at or under 0.69 FSI, the addition is no higher or closer to the side lot line than the existing house, and any earlier addition is at least 5 years old; raised platforms in the front or rear yard may not project into the required setback.

900.3.10(301).explanation: Exception RD 301 keeps each lot's 2013 frontage and area as the minimums, sets front setbacks measured from the street centreline (22.0 m Pharmacy Ave., 25.0 m Victoria Park Ave. or Warden Ave., 30 m Ellesmere Rd.), 0.9 m side setbacks (3.6 m on a street side), and 0.3 m for garages from an interior side lot line.
